calls.reason: The 2022 GAN paper guarantees incompressibility in a bounded domain. That challenges Marcus's broad wording, but does not settle his main point about guaranteeing physical consistency in Sora-like video generation.
Kang and colleagues studied separate diffusion models, not original Sora. Their results cannot establish the cause of Sora's glitches or rule out training-data deficiencies.
Kang's scaling experiments show limits, while Open-Sora fine-tuning shows that added data can improve physics. Neither establishes whether data alone can solve Sora's recurring glitches.
OpenAI reports improved physics, while Physics-IQ Verified finds later Sora 2 performance declining. These mixed results do not establish how difficult several original glitches were to fix.
